description: This Java class contains static validation methods for loan repayment periods in integration tests for the Fineract project. It provides various functions to verify the details of loan repayment schedules, such as amounts paid, outstanding, due dates, and status checks.

classes.name: LoanTestValidators
classes.description: A utility class with static methods to validate the correctness of loan repayment periods within integration tests.

methods.name: validateRepaymentPeriod
methods.description: Validates a specific repayment period against expected values, including due date, principal, fees, penalty, interest, and balancing paid/lost amounts.

methods.name: validateFullyUnpaidRepaymentPeriod
methods.description: Validates that a repayment period is fully unpaid, with corresponding due amounts and zero paid or outstanding amounts for fees, penalties, and interest.

methods.name: validateFullyPaidRepaymentPeriod
methods.description: Validates that a repayment period is fully paid, with all principal, fees, penalty, and interest paid out, optionally including late payment.

methods.name: verifyLoanStatus
methods.description: Checks that the loan's status matches a condition specified by the provided function.
